comment: Catalyzes the formation of the beta-lactam ring in the biosynthetic pathway of penicillin and related antibiotics.

changelog.comment: New entry. Added original ref and removed another (not relevant) one. Minor corrections to descriptions.

reactions.description: Cyclization of the ACV substrate to isopenicillin N in the biosynthetic pathway of beta-lactam antibiotics
Cyclization of δ-(L-α-aminoadipoyl)-L-cysteinyl-D-valine (LLD-ACV) tripeptide to isopenicillin N.
